option_relations.rationale: The option describes cavernous sinus syndrome secondary to lymphoma, which is equivalent to lymphomatous invasion of the cavernous sinus.
The option describes CD5+ Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma presenting as Cavernous Sinus Syndrome, which is a specific type of lymphoma causing cavernous sinus invasion.
The option describes Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma with cavernous sinus involvement, which is equivalent to lymphomatous invasion of the cavernous sinus.
Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma with CNS involvement is a broader category that includes lymphomatous invasion of the cavernous sinus.
